PROCEDURAL SCI-FI SFX - LICENCE

You may use these sounds in commercial and non-commercial projects: games,
film, video, applications, installations and advertising, on any number of
titles, with no attribution required and no royalties owed.

You may modify, layer, process and re-pitch them freely, and you may
distribute them as part of a finished work.

You may NOT resell or redistribute the sounds themselves, in whole or in part,
as a sound library, sample pack, or asset collection, whether modified or
unmodified.

Every file was synthesised from a physical or signal model. No third-party
recordings are redistributed in this library.
